name: Dropbox
description: Dropbox lets agents list, search, read and upload files and folders, and create share links. Each user signs in to their own Dropbox account through the browser.

prompts.text: Find the latest version of the Q3 report in my Dropbox.
Summarize the PDFs in my Contracts folder.
Save this draft to my Dropbox Drafts folder.

apps.name: Dropbox
apps.description: File search, reading, upload, and sharing, over Dropbox's MCP server with browser sign-in.
